card.name: Words right before "specific" or "specificity"
card.fires_on: The word just before "specific" or "specificity", such as "of" after "lack", "or" after "sensitive", or "non" in "non-specific". It appears in test-accuracy and symptom descriptions.

modes.label: Lack of specificity
modes.description: The word "of" after "lack" when the next word is specificity, in notes on false-positive screening tests.
modes.example: This is due to lack<< of>> specificity of the screening tests.

modes.label: Sensitive or specific
modes.description: The word "or" between "sensitive" and "specific" when describing a test method.
modes.example: ECG is not a sensitive<< or>> specific method for following anthracycline

modes.label: Non-specific symptoms
modes.description: The start of "non-specific" or "nonspecific" before symptoms.
modes.example: accompanied only by<< non>>-specific symptoms such as malaise, my

card.plain: It fires on the word right before "specific", as in "lack of specificity" or "non-specific symptoms".
